style_base: Crude hand-drawn cartoon in the style of the 'Ecomonos' YouTube channel. PURE WHITE background as the default. Thick bold black ink outlines, flat solid colors, NO gradients, NO blur, NO depth of field, NO glow effects, NO soft shading — everything sharp, crisp and clean like a marker drawing. A recurring brown cartoon monkey character with VERY LARGE round white eyes and small black pupils, and a hugely exaggerated expressive face (wide toothy grin, shocked open mouth, half-lidded smug look, or furrowed angry brow depending on the moment). The monkey is BIG in frame, occupying roughly 40-60% of the image — never a tiny figure lost in a wide empty scene. Props and objects are drawn in bright saturated colors (yellow, orange, red, green, blue) that pop against the white background. The image must contain NO text at all: no words, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no signs and no labels. Every poster, plaque, shield, price tag, badge, calendar, screen and sheet of paper is drawn completely BLANK. The Spanish captions are added afterwards in the edit, so drawing them here would duplicate them and misspell them. Tell the whole idea with drawing, gesture and facial expression alone. Characters have exactly two arms and two hands. Only use a dark or moody background when the scene itself is explicitly at night, in a dark room, or lit by police lights — otherwise the background stays white.  Cuando la escena lo pida, dibuja DENTRO de la imagen (nunca superpuesto) una cifra grande y, como mucho, una palabra corta en espanol relacionada con ESA escena concreta -- nunca reutilices cifras ni palabras de otras escenas, y si la escena no pide ninguna cifra no dibujes ninguna. Prefiere medallones/monedas doradas circulares para numeros sueltos en vez de calendarios/tablones de madera, salvo que la escena sea explicitamente sobre dias/meses transcurridos.

frames.text: Pero el coste de protegerte es casi cero y el coste de limpiarlo después son años.
frames.scene: Medium shot: a tiny simple shield icon with a near-zero-sized price tag on the left, versus a giant heavy stack of papers with a long calendar-page plaque on the right, dramatic size contrast, no characters.

frames.text: Esa asimetría es todo el argumento.
frames.scene: Close-up: a giant simple balance-scale icon tipped dramatically to one side, the protagonist brown monkey pointing at it, explanatory pose.

frames.text: Y que que de claro,
frames.scene: Close-up of the protagonist brown monkey raising one hand, about to clarify something important.

frames.text: esto es divulgación para que sepas defenderte, no un manual para nadie.
frames.scene: Medium shot: the protagonist brown monkey holding a giant shield icon protectively, calm reassuring stance, white background.

frames.text: Todo lo que ha soído está en informes públicos y en sentencias publicadas.
frames.scene: Close-up: a giant blank report folder/booklet stack with a simple gavel icon on top, plain presentation, no characters.

frames.text: Si esto te ha hecho mirar tu galería de fotos con otra cara, suscríbete. Se viene más de este mundo.
frames.scene: Wide shot: the protagonist brown monkey smiling warmly at the camera, holding up a phone with a photo-gallery icon, a giant simple bell/subscribe-shaped icon glowing beside it, warm inviting close of the video.
